aimassist.training.title: AimAssist · Practice arena
aimassist.training.subtitle: Learn your mouse movement with a local low-rank adapter.
aimassist.training.controls: Move the crosshair; click or hold left mouse to attack the bright target.
aimassist.training.ready: Profile ready · %s samples · LoRA can imitate your movement.
aimassist.training.collecting: %s / %s total · Complete every scenario; LoRA uses Assist until ready.
aimassist.training.local_note: Practice and profile stay on this computer. Back saves changes.
aimassist.training.reset_done: Training cleared. Start to record a new aiming style.
aimassist.training.save_failed: Cannot save. Retry Save, or Back again to leave without saving.
aimassist.training.load_failed: The saved profile could not be loaded. Fresh local practice is available.
aimassist.training.small_window: Enlarge the window or lower GUI scale to begin training.
text.Lock slides firmly on attack, Assis: Lock slides firmly on attack, Assist slows near targets, LoRA imitates local practice.
text.Maximum distance to the target in b: Maximum distance to the target in blocks.
text.Full angle in degrees within which: Full angle in degrees within which a target can be selected.
text.Maximum assisted camera speed in de: Maximum assisted camera speed in degrees per second.
text.Assist and LoRA correction strength: Assist and LoRA correction strength, including Assist mouse slowdown, in percent.
text.Assist and LoRA work only while att: Assist and LoRA work only while attacking. Lock always requires an attack press.
text.Amount of smooth variation based on: Amount of smooth variation based on the learned movement residual, in percent.
text.Open local practice for LoRA. Untra: Open local practice for LoRA. Untrained LoRA uses Assist until all scenarios have enough samples.
text.Smooth visible aiming with Lock, ad: Smooth visible aiming with Lock, adaptive Assist and locally trained LoRA.
text.Repeats held attacks with variable: Repeats held attacks with variable CPS, or adds timed clicks after each physical attack.
text.Auto repeats while the attack key i: Auto repeats while the attack key is held. Helper adds clicks after each physical press.
text.Minimum requested Auto CPS. Frame r: Minimum requested Auto CPS. Frame rate and vanilla attack delays can lower actual CPS.
text.Maximum Auto CPS. Reversed Min and: Maximum Auto CPS. Reversed Min and Max values are handled automatically.
text.Slow correlated CPS drift amplitude: Slow correlated CPS drift amplitude. Zero disables the drift.
text.Per-click interval variation in mil: Per-click interval variation in milliseconds, kept inside the CPS range.
text.Independent random pace variation i: Independent random pace variation in percent. Zero uses the midpoint before drift and jitter.
text.Maximum extra clicks after each phy: Maximum extra clicks after each physical press. A new press replaces unfinished extras.
text.Milliseconds between Helper clicks,: Milliseconds between Helper clicks, starting after the original click is processed.
